title: Unconditional Security of Discrete-Modulated CV-QKD from Infinite-Dimensional MEAT
summary: Discrete-Modulated (DM) Continuous-Variable (CV) Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) is an experimentally attractive approach to quantum cryptography, offering high key rates over metropolitan-scale distances while relying on state-of-the-art telecom infrastructure. However, a fundamental gap has remained between this experimental promise and rigorous security: for more than two decades, DM CV-QKD has lacked a complete composable finite-size security proof against coherent attacks.
